messages:
Rowan Park: hey folks — really excited to join Redwood as a Senior Infra Eng! :wave: i’m based in oakland, love tiny hardware projects, and i collect cassette tapes + build handheld synths. bringing a portable rig and a box of mixtapes if anyone wants a rooftop tape swap this friday around 7pm? bringing a small amp and some chai.
Margo Liu: welcome Rowan!! :tada: rooftop tape swap sounds rad. do you have a sample of your mixes? link? :ears:
Rowan Park: sure — here’s a quick one i made last month <https://soundcloud.com/rowan/mini-mixtape-03>. expect a weird blend of 80s synth, field recordings, and a couple of courtship kazoo hits. :grin:
Devlin: omg courtship kazoo hits = must attend. can you bring a battery speaker? ours are all at the office gym. :)
Rowan Park: yep i’ll bring a small battery amp and a patch cable. if it rains we can move to the 6th floor lounge.
Samir Goyal: hi Rowan — welcome! i’ll put a quick rooftop request with facilities. any dietary stuff we should know for snacks (vegan/peanut)?
Rowan Park: vegan ok, but i’ll have some masala chai (contains dairy) — i can make a vegan batch too. also happy to BYO snacks.
Margo Liu: poll time — friday 7pm :friday: vs saturday 4pm :saturday:. react with :one: for friday or :two: for saturday
Devlin: :one:
Samir Goyal: :one: — facilities noted, filing the request now.
welcome-bot: Welcome @Rowan Park to #new-hires! Organization note: onboarding checklist assigned. :sparkles:
Rowan Park: thanks all, appreciate the warm welcome. i’ll drop a calendar invite (title: "Rooftop Tape Swap — Rowan") in a bit. if anyone wants to bring tracks to trade, DM me. :cassette: :synth:
